svg.title: Skillz: research evidence and selected reference methods across 33 capability domains
svg.desc: Two separate measurement stages. The November 2 research baseline shows 210 of 247 topics with at least one review or candidate link, which may be rejected. The November 3 bounded consumer shelf has 19 Valuable Reference methods across nine domains and 18 topic mappings. Zero skills are approved unchanged. See the README for a full domain-by-domain text alternative. Nothing here certifies full capability coverage.
svg.text: Capability search: evidence links versus featured methods
Two evidence stages. Neither is proof that a skill is safe to install or that a domain is mature.
0 featured = not promoted to this shelf; search the wider library for other useful methods.
